description: Simulates a 6-turn coding workflow cost projection comparing unrouted flagship execution against tiered routing across grant pools and warm-cached GA models. Stateless in-memory calculation requiring no authentication and mutating no router settings. Scales per-turn cost linearly with context_tokens relative to current_model; when has_custom_router_config is true, reports a non-intrusive shadow comparison rather than active target IDs. Returns JSON with custom_router_mutex_check, six_turn_cost_breakdown (1 cold write turn + 5 warm read turns), and net_saved_usd (positive USD saved vs unrouted baseline). Use this tool when planning multi-turn task allocation; use check_context_cliff for single-turn length checks or reconcile_usage_receipt for post-hoc invoice auditing.

context_tokens.description: Estimated prompt token count per turn (e.g. 80000 to 200000).

current_model.description: Currently configured primary model ID in the user's IDE.

has_custom_router_config.description: When true, preserves user's existing router and outputs a non-intrusive shadow comparison; when false, outputs active routing targets.

task_instruction.description: Coding or architectural task description used to classify complexity tier.

name: auto_route_task_by_quality_tier
